1. PARTIES AND PREMISES
This Residential Lease Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into between Okafor Property Holdings, LLC ("Landlord") and Colin Reyes ("Tenant").
1.2 Premises: The leased premises are located at 702 Everly Terrace, Unit 39, Portland, Oregon (the "Premises").
1.3 The Premises shall be used exclusively as a private residential dwelling and for no other purpose whatsoever.
